1.consolidated_definition: med. Paciente desahuciado. Enfermo que está en la etapa final de una enfermedad mortal. Usual. DRAE, desde 2001. Las Hijas de la Caridad sirven a nuestros enfermos del Hospital Auxilio Mutuo desde 1884, un año después de su fundación. Se dedican al cuidado pastoral de los enfermos: visitan a los pacientes, los escuchan, les oran, le prestan pequeños servicios, les preparan para la recepción de los sacramentos y otros. A pacientes terminales les ayudan en su proceso de muerte con dignidad (Hospital Auxilio Mutuo, consultado 22-01-08)
1.en_consolidated_definition:
Patient pronounced terminal. A patient in the final stage of a mortal illness. Usual. 

A patient who is terminally ill. One who is in the last stage of a fatal disease.

Terminal patient. A person suffering from an incurable or fatal disease, especially one in its final stages.

 Terminally ill patient. A person with a serious and usually incurable medical condition that is expected to result in death.

Patient at end-of-life. A person whose illness has progressed to the point where it is no longer possible for them to recover.

Terminal case. A patient who is suffering from an advanced or fatal disease, especially one in its final stages.

 Terminally ill individual. A person with a serious and usually incurable medical condition that is expected to result in death.

 Patient in terminal stage of illness. A person whose illness has progressed to the point where it is no longer possible for them to recover.

Patient with terminal illness. A person suffering from an advanced or fatal disease, especially one in its final stages.

 Terminally ill person. A person with a serious and usually incurable medical condition that is expected to result in death.

 Patient at end of life stage. A person whose illness has progressed to the point where it is no longer possible for them to recover.

Patient in terminal phase. A person suffering from an advanced or fatal disease, especially one in its final stages.

 Terminally ill individual. A person with a serious and usually incurable medical condition that is expected to result
